history.title: Our History
history.p1: BEJUCA Consulting was founded in 2010 in Tucumán, Argentina, with the vision of bringing innovation to organizations in a strategic and human way. What began as a family project has grown into a business consultancy recognized for integrating engineering rigor with the freshness of professional communication.
history.p2: For over 15 years, we have accompanied companies from various sectors through their digital transformation processes. Our journey has allowed us to evolve from basic system optimization to custom software development and high-complexity technological infrastructure solutions.
history.p3: Our commitment to technical excellence and strategic brand positioning allows us to build lasting relationships. More than just service providers, we become allies to each organization, understanding their reality to design digital ecosystems that drive sales and authority.
history.p4: From our beginnings, we have maintained an interdisciplinary approach strongly focused on human capital. We specialize in supporting team evolution through non-formal training backed by international certifications. To date, we have trained dozens of professionals, transforming them into essential assets for their organizations and ensuring their talent gains high-value recognition within the industry.
history.p5: Today, with a team of four expert professionals and a deep vocation, we remain committed to constant innovation. We continue to resolve our clients' bottlenecks, ensuring that every technological solution generates a real, measurable, and sustainable impact on their business.
